pillars.name: Treatment education
pillars.guidance: Explain one treatment or skin concern clearly: what it is, who it suits, what to expect. Grounded in the approved treatments page copy — no claims that aren't on the site. Educational without lecturing.

pillars.name: Myth-busting
pillars.guidance: Take one common misconception (aesthetics = frozen faces, tightening lasers hurt, injectables are one-size-fits-all) and correct it with calm expertise. Straight-talking, never mocking the reader for believing the myth.

pillars.name: Clinic & practitioner trust
pillars.guidance: Why medically-led matters: Nafisa's approach, consultation-first ethos, safety standards, honest suitability assessments (including when she says no). The client is the subject, not the treatment.

pillars.name: Patient journey & aftercare
pillars.guidance: What a first visit looks like, how consultations work, aftercare guidance, realistic timelines for results. Reduces fear of the unknown for first-timers.

pillars.name: Seasonal & timely
pillars.guidance: Season-relevant skin advice (summer SPF, post-holiday skin, event-season prep). Never discount-led — timeliness is the hook, not price.
